div.head: Ine 13.1
div.ab: Þeofas we hatað oð seofon men; from seofon monnum hloð oþ XXXV; siððan bið here.
Ðeofas we hatað oð VII men; from VII hloð oð XXXV; siððan bið here.
Fures nominamus usque ad VII homines; a septem hloþ (id est cohortem uel satellites) usque ad XXXV; deinceps est here (id est exercitus).
Ðeofas we hateð oð VII men; from VII hloð oð XXXV; siððen bið here.
[A group of] up to seven men we call thieves; from seven to thirty-five a band; more is a troop.
We use the term 'thieves' if the number of men does not exceed seven, 'band of marauders' for a number between seven and thirty-five. Anything beyond this is a 'raid.'
‘Diebe’ nennen wir [Personen] bis 7 Mann; von 7 bis 35: ‘Bande’; darüber hinaus ist [es] ein ‘Heer’.
We call [persons] up to 7 men ‘thieves’; from 7 to 35, a ‘band’; beyond that it is an ‘army’.
